Direct GLOBALS and direct GLOBALS dimension refetch bypass lookup. The special list direct try-CV path can record a benign GLOBALS request.
Deduplication preserves first request order. Runtime initialization and callback results must be defined from primitive request input separately.
Four author capture prediction mistakes are preserved separately from the actual first descriptor defect. Neither is relabeled a runtime disagreement.
